continental_geometry.failure: nonpositive mantle residual is invalid; never clamp
continental_geometry.mantle_thickness: h_total - cellwise authored continental crust thickness

asthenosphere.reason: avoid a fabricated compositional density jump; density is evaluated at same reference T and composition
asthenosphere.source: reuse shared mantle reference at potential temperature; thermal expansion supplies temperature contrast

continental_crust.reason: mid-range bulk crust proxy; does not assert cellwise composition
continental_crust.source: Christensen & Mooney (1995), seismic structure/density of continental crust; standard reference range

oceanic_crust.reason: central value of published ocean-crust estimate
oceanic_crust.source: Christensen & Mooney (1995), preferred mean 2.89 +/- 0.04 Mg m-3

material_classes.scope: one homogeneous bulk reference only; no thermal-class-dependent composition
one homogeneous bulk reference; explicit crust above HWR effective plate

material_classes.geometry_source: continental T0 total thickness less crust; ocean HWR total thermal plate less crust under stated mapping

material_classes.scope: one reference state; same mantle composition and thermal expansion for minimum package

ocean_geometry.ridge: z=0 age uses finite q_ridge=0.3; zp nominal supplies only an explicitly authorial reference geometry until a ridge initial thermal profile is specified

continental_crust.reason: round, low bulk value compatible with authored 45-85 mW m-2 while retaining uncertainty; not a regional or historical Earth estimate
continental_crust.source: Sammon et al. (2022) reports crustal-average radiogenic surface contribution ~26.7-39.6 mW m-2 across Earth compositional models and discusses upper-crust 0.8-1.75 uW m-3; Jaupart & Mareschal (2015) review bulk crust estimates

mantle_lithosphere.reason: small nonzero reference keeps zero an explicit sensitivity endpoint rather than hidden default
mantle_lithosphere.source: Hasterok & Webb (2017) continental lithosphere thermal models discuss mantle heat production <=0.04 uW m-3; use low reference prior

radiogenic_heat.model: Single uniform bulk production per crust material; no depth layers or thermal-class composition classes.

oceanic_crust.reason: minimal bulk mafic-crust proxy; no claim of Arcana geochemistry
oceanic_crust.source: Kumar et al. (2020) LitMod2D table uses oceanic crust 0.30 uW m-3

radiogenic_heat.uncertainty_policy: These are authorial specialist reference values with stated literature-based sensitivity, not cellwise fields or reconstructed Earth.

reference_temperatures.TADIAB_binding: Set TADIAB=Tp at the reference surface-pressure datum z=0; GRADIE=local derivative at Tp for compatibility only; TAsthK at 100 km is derived from integrated adiabat and must be evaluated through explicit code binding. The source's linear formula differs from exact integration by <0.1 K over 100 km at nominal values.
reference_temperatures.adiabatic_relation: dT/dz=alpha*g*T/Cp; use exponential integration T(z)=Tp*exp(alpha*g*z/Cp) for constant properties; linear GRADIE is local derivative only.
reference_temperatures.alpha: same selected mantle alpha authority used for lithosphere and adiabat; do not create duplicate value.

potential_temperature_K.derivation: nominal HWR Tb - gamma*100 km; gamma=alpha*g*T/Cp, evaluated locally at Tb; range is conservative combination of HWR Tb, alpha, Cp extrema

rhoAst.binding: same mantle density authority evaluated at potential-temperature reference

reference_temperatures.solidus_limits: No universal solidus is assigned: temLim in this source is a numerical density-integration cap and literature solidus varies with composition, pressure and volatiles. This is outside the minimal conductive reference-state authority; any required runtime cap must be separately governed before OrbData config.

Cp.source: Glazner et al. (2021) representative rock value 1000

alpha.source: silicate-rock thermophysical range; HWR mantle alpha used only as order-of-magnitude prior

k.source: Jaupart & Mareschal (2011) crustal heat transfer; representative conductivity ~2.1; Glazner et al. (2021) uses 2.5

thermal_properties.heat_capacity_consumer: Crust Cp recorded for reusable completeness; OrbData Assign does not consume Cp. Only mantle Cp feeds HWR diffusivity.

alpha.source: silicate-rock thermophysical range; specialist proxy, not composition inference

k.source: Kumar et al. (2020) LitMod2D representative oceanic crust k=2.2; range allows bulk lithologic variability
